\chapter{Development results}\label{ch:development}
These results come from the instrument while it is in development. Each was tested against a prediction or a pass bar committed before its data were read, and each names its record in the repository. \section{IAM-A, first physics lever: cutting the methyl supply}
Mat1a knockout mice cannot make S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) in the liver, so the methyl supply to the copier falls. IAM's Law, through the restore rate of DNMT1, gives the rise in copy error; mapped through Stage~Q's measured response on one healthy mouse's molecules, the window was committed (49ab1e6) before any knockout file was read. Liver RRBS, aligned reads, 8 healthy and 6 knockout mice.

\begin{center}\small
\begin{tabular}{@{}p{0.58\linewidth}p{0.16\linewidth}p{0.18\linewidth}@{}}
\toprule quantity & value & status \\\midrule
sealed window, IAM-A knockout $\div$ healthy & 1.016--1.135 & \prediction \\ \rowrule
read, IAM-A knockout $\div$ healthy & 1.124 & \measured \\ \rowrule
one-sided Mann--Whitney $p$, knockout above healthy & 0.0003 & \measured \\ \rowrule
knockout with SAMe restored $\div$ healthy & 1.098 & \measured \\ \rowrule
\end{tabular}
\end{center}
The knockout livers also develop steatohepatitis, a second route downstream of the same SAM loss; this set does not separate the two.
Record: \path{doors/DEV_SAM_LEVER_01_OUTCOME.md} (2026-10-10).

\section{Met-A reproduces across laboratories on identical DNA}
The same DNA of 7 reference cell lines (SEQC2 EpiQC), run on EPIC v1 at three laboratories, 30 arrays, read by the chain unchanged. The cell lines are read on the neutrophil scale, so the readings test reproducibility, not health.

\begin{center}\small

\section{Met-A raises no false alarm when foreign DNA is mixed in}
One donor's blood DNA with 4--15~\% liver, lung, colon or neuron DNA mixed in at known fractions (Moss 2018), 9 EPIC arrays. Foreign DNA at these fractions does not move the neutrophil identity sites, so Met-A must stay where the unmixed blood reads.

\begin{center}\small
\begin{tabular}{@{}p{0.58\linewidth}p{0.16\linewidth}p{0.18\linewidth}@{}}
\toprule quantity & value & status \\\midrule
sealed bar: Normal and within 0.03 of the unmixed blood & 9 of 9 & \measured \\ \rowrule
largest shift in $A$ & 0.0094 & \measured \\ \rowrule
\end{tabular}
\end{center}
Record: \path{doors/DEV_CSCORE_MOSS_01_OUTCOME.md} (2026-10-10).
